job: Standing up a deployment-replay layer that regenerates de-identified production traffic through a candidate model to measure behavioral drift before shipping.
outcome: A labeled traffic-replay eval gate named in the lab's published model or safety card as a complement to targeted evals.
motivation: Fixed benchmarks and red-teaming miss usage-driven drift; competitive and safety-reporting pressure makes omitting an equivalent replay signal untenable.

task.who: the lab's pre-release evaluations / model-safety team
task.what: replay de-identified production traffic through candidate model and measure drift
task.where: the pre-deployment eval pipeline feeding the release gate
task.when: the runway from June 2026 through Q2 2027
task.why: catch drift that fixed benchmarks and red-teaming miss
task.how: deployment-replay over a sampled de-identified traffic corpus

job: Extending the published replay method to agentic-coding tool calls and demonstrating calibrated rate forecasts on real production traffic.
outcome: A proven, calibrated replay technique covering agentic tool-call behavior that peers feel pressure to match.
motivation: Demonstrating calibrated real-traffic forecasts sets the safety-reporting bar and makes the technique hard for peer labs to ignore.

task.who: the originating lab's deployment-simulation / safety-research team
task.what: extend replay to agentic-coding tool calls; calibrate rate forecasts
task.where: the published Deployment Simulation method and its eval harness
task.when: the runway following the June 16 publication into 2027
task.why: raise the bar so peers must show an equivalent signal
task.how: calibrated forecasting over agentic tool-call replay traces

job: Drafting pre-deployment risk guidance that incorporates replay-based traffic evaluation as the practice generalizes across labs.
outcome: Replay-based pre-deployment risk language entering standards-body and regulator discussion documents.
motivation: A citable real-traffic technique that catches misalignment benchmarks miss gives standards-setters a concrete pattern to codify.

task.who: the standards-body / regulator pre-deployment-evaluation working group
task.what: draft replay-based pre-deployment risk language into guidance
task.where: standards-body guidance and regulator discussion documents
task.when: the runway as the practice generalizes through Q2 2027
task.why: codify a citable pattern for pre-deployment risk evaluation
